title: The "10 espressos in 10 minutes" challenge is taking over feeds
summary: A fast-spreading dare: people film themselves downing ten espressos back to back against a timer, then post shaky, wired reactions and tag friends to beat the record. Replies are a pile-on of 'drink more, go harder' one-upmanship, with a growing number of comments warning about heart palpitations and nausea. The tone is loud, competitive and mocking of anyone who stops early.
